---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new capability for OpenCitizen AI
title: "feat(<scope>): <brief description of proposed feature>"
labels: ["enhancement", "feature"]
assignees: []
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

## Problem Statement / Civic Use Case
Is your feature request related to a specific civic problem or analysis bottleneck?
> Example: "As a civic researcher, I need to analyze municipal procurement budgets by vendor across multiple fiscal quarters..."

## Proposed Solution & Architecture
Describe the solution you'd like:
- API endpoints / data models
- Ingestion, analytical, or retrieval changes
- Frontend components / visualization support
- Dependencies (if any)

## Evidence Grounding & Verification
How does this feature align with OpenCitizen AI's core principles of verifiable calculation, source grounding, and inspectability?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or public dataset examples here.
